title: [T-013] Integrate borrowed binary stdin acquisition
body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-013 -->

Scope: textstats/cli.py and source/lifecycle unit/integration checks. Depends on: historical T-012 baseline and accepted text-only amendment.

Outcome: INPUT - reads bytes until EOF, strict UTF-8 independent of locale, never closes stdin; ./- remains a named-file path; text output/BOM policies share whole-input counting (S-6).

Evidence: actual subprocess piped ordinary/empty/non-ASCII/BOM bytes in text output and non-UTF-8 locale settings; instrument borrowed stream lifetime and retained named-file behavior. Keep acquisition separate from decoded-text processing for future selection compatibility.

Current accepted scope: exact text output, BOM policy and named-file ranges; JSON output/S-5 is retired. --json is usage2 before acquisition; literal --json filenames work after --. Stdin/final work remains pending; no stdin ranges.

Accepted amendment: f04f1c3da9fe6cabf92f506a422d6aa3e146078c, docs/dev/reports/phases/2/revisions/003_0e47414/REVISION-REPORT.md. Retained named-file amendment verified unit22/integration13, isolated source and9public blocks; this does not complete pending T-013–T-017.

<!-- /sdd-forge:task-id=T-013 -->
